Boocord Music Discord 5.0.0 is a complete Java rewrite of the former Node.js bot.

Highlights:

- Discord Components V2 across commands, lists, feedback, and the now-playing dashboard
- Direct in-process playback with JDA, Lavaplayer, and Discord DAVE encryption
- Queue controls, shuffle, track/queue repeat, favorites, lyrics, volume, and listening stats
- German and English interfaces
- Automatic database migrations and playback-session restoration
- Patched dependencies, unit tests, static analysis, dependency convergence checks, and CI

This is a breaking runtime upgrade. Java 17+ and Maven 3.9+ replace Node.js and npm. Back up the database and `.env`, compare it with the new `.env.example`, and follow the [owner update guide](https://github.com/BoocordStudios/BoocordMusicDiscord/blob/v5.0.0/docs/OWNER_UPDATE_GUIDE.md).

The attached JAR targets Linux x86-64 with glibc. Builds for other DAVE-supported platforms can be produced from source by overriding `libdave.native.artifact` as documented in the README. The `.sha256` asset can be used to verify the download.

The MIT license applies to the source code. API-delivered music and metadata remain subject to the [Boocord Music API and Content Terms](https://github.com/BoocordStudios/BoocordMusicDiscord/blob/v5.0.0/API_TERMS.md).
